title: Answer
description:
An oath that will not relent outranks a command that merely takes a man.

The surety is a person who has taken the place, and what he guarantees is the covenant in which the law is written inside and sins are not remembered.

Intercession is bearing the people on the heart, and it belongs with the poured-out life, not after it as a second work.

The bull for himself, and the rules against defilement, fall away. Nearness remains. Perfected means the hands filled, once, for a priest already without sin.
